Implements per-subject adaptive ensemble with strict cross-validation model selection.

items.raw_excerpt: Per-subject adaptive ensemble for binary motor-imagery EEG (held-out test 0.93 on BCI-ISLA 2026; tied for top score with 2 other participants among 114 on the development leaderboard, Inria-organised). Strictly cross-validation-driven model selection.
